tasks.prompt: a  Which of the foods/drinks do you like?
tasks.answer: I like pizza, ice-cream, grapes and orange juice.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and'.
O'zingiz yoqtirgan ovqatlarni ayting.
tasks.speak: a  Which of the foods/drinks do you like?

tasks.prompt: a  Which of the foods/drinks don't you like?
tasks.answer: I don't like coconut, garlic or beer.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
DIQQAT: INKOR gapda sanashda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: a  Which of the foods/drinks don't you like?

tasks.answer: Lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, onion and garlic are vegetables.
tasks.promptUz: Yerda o'sadigan, taom uchun ishlatiladigan o'simliklar
tasks.whyUz:
SABZAVOTLAR — rasmda o'ng tomonda joylashgan.
DIQQAT: pomidor botanik jihatdan MEVA, lekin oshxonada
SABZAVOT hisoblanadi.

tasks.answer: Steak, sausage, hot-dog, bacon, roast chicken and hamburger are meat.
tasks.whyUz:
GO'SHT taomlari — rasmda pastki qatorda.
'meat' — sanalmaydigan ot ('meats' odatda ishlatilmaydi).

tasks.answer: Pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries, bananas, orange, apple and grapes are fruit.
tasks.promptUz: Daraxt va butalarda o'sadigan shirin mahsulotlar
tasks.whyUz:
MEVALAR — rasmda chap yuqori burchakda.
'fruit' — odatda SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'I eat a lot of fruit.'
'fruits' faqat turli TURLARI haqida.

tasks.answer: Chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie and biscuits are sweets.
tasks.whyUz:
SHIRINLIKLAR — rasmda chap o'rta qismda.
'sweets' = shirinliklar (britancha); amerikacha 'candy'.

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat breakfast?
tasks.answer: I eat breakfast at seven o'clock in the morning.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
'have breakfast' ham to'g'ri: 'I have breakfast at seven.'
DIQQAT: 'breakfast' oldida artikl KERAK EMAS.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat breakfast?

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat lunch?
tasks.answer: I eat lunch at one o'clock in the afternoon.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. 'lunch' — tushlik.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat lunch?

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat dinner?
tasks.answer: I eat dinner at seven o'clock in the evening.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. 'dinner' — kunning asosiy ovqati,
odatda kechqurun.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat dinner?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat fruit?
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
Chastota ifodalari: every day, twice a week, once a month,
always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat fruit?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat sweets?
tasks.answer: I eat sweets twice a week.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat sweets?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat vegetables?
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat vegetables?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat meat?
tasks.answer: I eat meat three or four times a week.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. '... times a week' — haftasiga ... marta.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat meat?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods/drinks can you have for breakfast?
tasks.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, bread, cheese, coffee, tea, milk or orange juice for breakfast.
tasks.whyUz:
'have ... FOR breakfast' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Nonushtaga yengil va tez tayyorlanadigan taomlar olinadi.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods/drinks can you have for breakfast?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for dessert?
tasks.answer: You can have ice-cream, chocolate cake, apple pie, biscuits or fruit for dessert.
tasks.whyUz:
'dessert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin).
DIQQAT: 'desert' /ˈdezət/ = cho'l — boshqa so'z!
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for dessert?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for a light meal?
tasks.answer: You can have salad, tomato soup, a sandwich or grilled fish for a light meal.
tasks.whyUz:
'a light meal' = yengil ovqat (aksi: 'a heavy meal').
Salat va sho'rva — eng yengil taomlar.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for a light meal?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for a traditional English breakfast?
tasks.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, sausages, tomatoes, bread and tea for a traditional English breakfast.
tasks.promptUz: An'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi — issiq va to'yimli
tasks.whyUz:
AN'ANAVIY INGLIZ NONUSHTASI (a full English breakfast):
  qovurilgan tuxum, bekon, sosiska, pomidor, loviya,
  qovurilgan non va choy.
Bu — dunyodagi eng to'yimli nonushtalardan biri.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for a traditional English breakfast?

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 'Laura's' degan yangi restoran haqidagi reklama.

Moslikni GRAMMATIKA va MANTIQ bilan topish mumkin —
audio faqat tekshirish uchun:

  1 'The new family restaurant' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is on Bridge Street' (joy)
  2 'The food is' — 'is' bor, sifat kerak
     → 'very well cooked'
  3 'A meal for two' — ega, narx kerak

  4 'The service' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is excellent'
  5 'Laura's is open' — ish vaqti kerak
     → 'from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'

DIQQAT — 'Laura's':
  Restoran nomi egalik apostrofi bilan — 'Lauraniki'.
  Inglizchada restoran va do'kon nomlari ko'pincha shunday:
  McDonald's, Sainsbury's, Harrod's.

         tasty, book, tomato, pepper, special

'pepper steak' = qalampirli bifshteks.
Gap: There is pepper steak on the menu.

'tomato sauce' = pomidor sousi.

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: knife, fork, plate, frying-pan, spoon

OSHXONA VA DASTURXON BUYUMLARI:
  a spoon ....... qoshiq (dumaloq, chuqurchali)
  a fork ........ vilka (uchli tishlari bor)
  a knife ....... pichoq (tig'i bor)
  a plate ....... tarelka (yassi)
  a frying-pan .. qovurish tovasi (dastasi bor)

RASMLARDAGI TARTIB:
  1 — qoshiq   2 — tarelka   3 — pichoq
  4 — vilka    5 — qovurish tovasi

DIQQAT — TALAFFUZ:
  knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI!
  Ko'pligi: knife → KNIVES (f → ves)

tasks.whyUz:
Sho'rva SUYUQ → qoshiq kerak.
'eat WITH a spoon' — asbob uchun WITH.

'to serve food' = ovqat tortmoq.
'ON a plate' — tarelka YUZASIDA → ON.

'to cut' = kesmoq.
Talaffuz: knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI.
Ko'pligi: KNIVES.

tasks.prompt: 4  We pick up food with a ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'to pick up' = olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
Vilka bilan go'sht va sabzavot olinadi.
tasks.speak: 4  We pick up food with a ............ .

tasks.whyUz:
'to fry' = yog'da qovurmoq.
'IN a frying-pan' — tova ICHIDA → IN.
fry + -ing + pan (chiziqcha bilan).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about Laura's Restaurant.
exercises.instructionUz: Laura's restorani haqidagi matnni o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MATN — RESTORAN HAQIDAGI TAQRIZ (a review).

TUZILISHI (to'rt xatboshi):
  1) nomi, turi, joyi, ish vaqti
  2) taomlar va shirinliklar
  3) narx va xizmat
  4) tavsiya (recommendation)

Bu tuzilish 57-betdagi yozma ish uchun namuna bo'ladi.

QALIN YOZILGAN SO'ZLAR (3c-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  family restaurant, Don't miss the chance, home-made,
  dessert, slice, bowl, friendly, occasion, busy, don't forget

tasks.en: Laura's is the new family restaurant on Bridge Street and it's open for lunch and dinner every day.
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' — Bridge ko'chasidagi yangi oilaviy restoran va u har kuni tushlik hamda kechki ovqat uchun ochiq.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: a family restaurant = oilaviy restoran
(bolalar bilan borish mumkin, narxi o'rtacha).
'Laura's' — egalik apostrofi bilan restoran nomi.
'open FOR lunch' — 'for' predlogi shart.

tasks.en: The food is very well cooked.
tasks.note:
'well cooked' = yaxshi pishirilgan.
'well' — RAVISH ('good cooked' XATO).

tasks.en: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce, and lots of different salads.
tasks.uz: Tanlash uchun juda ko'p mazali taomlar bor: qalampirli bifshteks, qovurilgan tovuq, guruch bilan baliq, pomidor sho'rvasi, quyuq pomidor sousli makaron va turli-tuman salatlar.
tasks.note:
'such as' = masalan, ...kabi (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.
'rich' bu yerda = quyuq, to'yimli (boy emas!).
'a dish' = taom (bir tur).

tasks.en: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread — it's delicious!
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' ning uyda pishirilgan nonini tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang — u juda mazali!
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  Don't miss the chance = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang
  home-made = uyda tayyorlangan (home + made)
'delicious' = juda mazali ('tasty' dan kuchliroq).

tasks.en: For dessert, have a slice of the chef's superb apple pie, or a bowl of Laura's special ice-cream.
tasks.uz: Shirinlikka oshpazning ajoyib olmali pirogidan bir bo'lak yoki 'Laura's' ning maxsus muzqaymog'idan bir kosa oling.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  dessert /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin)
  a slice = bir bo'lak (pirog, non, pitsa uchun)
  a bowl = kosa, piyola
'a chef' /ʃef/ = oshpaz (restoranning bosh oshpazi).
'superb' = ajoyib.

tasks.en: A meal for two people costs about £25.
tasks.uz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.
tasks.note:
'A meal' — birlik ega → COSTS.
'£25' = 'twenty-five pounds' deb o'qiladi.

tasks.en: The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.
tasks.uz: Xizmat a'lo darajada, ofitsiantlar juda yordamchan va do'stona.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: friendly = do'stona, iliq muomalali.
'helpful' = yordamchan (help + -ful).
'a waiter' = ofitsiant (erkak); 'a waitress' = ofitsiant (ayol).

tasks.en: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
tasks.uz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

tasks.en: Laura's is a great restaurant for any occasion, but it is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' har qanday tadbir uchun ajoyib restoran, lekin u juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  an occasion = tadbir, munosabat (tug'ilgan kun, yubiley)
  busy = gavjum, band
  don't forget = unutmang
'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
'first' bu yerda = oldindan, avvaldan.

tasks.en: (Tel.: 6640306) Enjoy your meal!
tasks.note:
'Tel.' = telephone number ning qisqartmasi.
'Enjoy your meal!' — unit sarlavhasi ham shu.

exercises.instructionEn: Read text A about Brazil.
exercises.instructionUz: Braziliya haqidagi A matnini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
A MATNI — BRAZILIYA

QALIN SO'ZLAR: Whether ... or, office, strong coffee, As well as

BRAZILIYALIKLARNING ODATLARI:
  • do'st va oila bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi
  • tushlikni ishxonada YEMAYDI
  • kechki ovqatni juda kech — kechasi soat 10 larda qiladi
  • kuchli qahvani kichik piyolalarda ichadi
  • ko'chada va avtobusda ovqatlanmaydi
  • qo'l bilan ovqatlanmaydi — DOIM pichoq va vilka bilan

tasks.en: Whether at home or in a restaurant, Brazilians like eating with their friends and family.
tasks.uz: Uydami yoki restorandami, braziliyaliklar do'stlari va oilasi bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: 'whether ... or ...' = ...mi yoki ...mi (farqi yo'q).
'like + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'lidan keyin -ing.

tasks.en: They never eat lunch at the office and they have dinner very late — at about ten o'clock at night.
tasks.uz: Ular hech qachon ishxonada tushlik qilmaydi va kechki ovqatni juda kech — kechasi taxminan soat 10 da qiladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: 'an office' = ishxona, ofis.
'never' — chastota ravishi, fe'ldan OLDIN.
'have dinner' = kechki ovqat qilmoq.

tasks.en: Brazilians like small cups of strong coffee, at any time of the day.
tasks.uz: Braziliyaliklar kunning istalgan vaqtida kichik piyolalarda kuchli qahva ichishni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: 'strong coffee' = quyuq (kuchli) qahva.
'a cup of coffee' — miqdor iborasi (56-bet).
'at any time' = istalgan vaqtda.

tasks.en: As well as many different fruit drinks, Brazilians also make very good beer.
tasks.uz: Turli mevali ichimliklardan tashqari, braziliyaliklar juda yaxshi pivo ham tayyorlaydi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: 'as well as' = ...dan tashqari, shuningdek.
'also' = ham (gapda takrorlaydi).

tasks.en: They don't eat in the street or on the bus, and they never eat with their hands.
tasks.uz: Ular ko'chada yoki avtobusda ovqatlanmaydi va hech qachon qo'l bilan ovqatlanmaydi.
tasks.note:
INKOR gapda sanashda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
'IN the street' — britancha ('on the street' — amerikacha).
'ON the bus' — transportda ON.

tasks.en: They always use a knife and fork to eat, even for pizza or sandwiches.
tasks.uz: Ular ovqatlanish uchun doim pichoq va vilkadan foydalanadi — hatto pitsa yoki buterbrod uchun ham.
tasks.note:
'a knife and fork' — juftlik sifatida BITTA artikl bilan.
'even' = hatto.
'to eat' — maqsad ('ovqatlanish uchun').

exercises.instructionEn: Read text B about the Philippines.
exercises.instructionUz: Filippin haqidagi B matnini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
B MATNI — FILIPPIN

QALIN SO'ZLAR: snacks, invite, polite, leave

FILIPPINLIKLARNING ODATLARI:
  • kuniga uch mahal ovqat + orasida ikkita yengil gazak
  • GURUCH har bir ovqatning bir qismi
  • hatto shirinlikni ham guruch va kokos sutidan tayyorlaydi
  • sho'rva, go'sht, sabzavot va turli souslarni yaxshi ko'radi
  • mamlakatning ba'zi qismlarida vino tayyorlanadi
  • oilalar odatda birga ovqatlanadi
  • mehmon chaqirishni yaxshi ko'radi
  • VILKA va QOSHIQ bilan yoki QO'L bilan ovqatlanadi
  • ovqat oxirida tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish — ODOB

tasks.en: Many Filipinos have three meals a day with two snacks in between.
tasks.uz: Ko'p filippinliklar kuniga uch mahal ovqatlanadi va orasida ikki marta yengil gazak qiladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: 'a snack' = yengil gazak (asosiy ovqat emas).
'three meals A DAY' — 'a' bu yerda 'har' degani.
'in between' = orasida.

tasks.en: Rice is a part of every meal — they even make desserts with rice and coconut milk.
tasks.uz: Guruch har bir ovqatning bir qismi — ular hatto guruch va kokos sutidan shirinlik ham tayyorlaydi.
tasks.note:
'rice' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → fe'l BIRLIKDA: 'Rice IS'.
'even' = hatto. 'coconut milk' = kokos suti.

tasks.en: Filipinos like eating soup, meat, vegetables and a lot of different sauces.
tasks.uz: Filippinliklar sho'rva, go'sht, sabzavot va turli souslarni yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.

tasks.en: In some parts of the country, they make wine.
tasks.note:
'parts of the country' — 40-betdagi 'parts of the world' kabi.
DIQQAT: 16a-mashqdagi 3-gap uchun muhim — vino Finlandiyada emas,
FILIPPINDA tayyorlanadi.

tasks.en: Families usually eat together and they like to invite people to eat with them.
tasks.uz: Oilalar odatda birga ovqatlanadi va odamlarni o'zlari bilan ovqatlanishga taklif qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: 'to invite' = taklif qilmoq, chaqirmoq.
'like TO invite' — 'like' dan keyin 'to + fe'l' ham mumkin
(ma'nosi 'like + -ing' bilan deyarli bir xil).

tasks.en: Filipinos eat with a fork and a spoon, or with their hands.
tasks.uz: Filippinliklar vilka va qoshiq bilan yoki qo'l bilan ovqatlanadi.
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: PICHOQ emas! Vilka va QOSHIQ.
A matndagi braziliyaliklardan farqi — ular pichoq va vilka ishlatadi.

tasks.en: It's polite to leave a little food on the plate at the end of a meal.
tasks.uz: Ovqat oxirida tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish — odob belgisi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  polite = odobli, muloyim
  to leave = qoldirmoq
'a little food' — 'food' sanalmaydi → A LITTLE (57-bet).
'It's polite TO + fe'l' — o'zgarmas qolip.

exercises.instructionEn: Read text C about Finland.
exercises.instructionUz: Finlandiya haqidagi C matnini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
C MATNI — FINLANDIYA

QALIN SO'ZLAR: such as, smoked fish, popular, stalls,
               sell, each person, brings

FINLARNING ODATLARI:
  • milliy taomlar: dudlangan baliq va issiq sho'rvalar
  • tez ovqat (pitsa, sosiska) ham juda mashhur
  • ko'chalarda sosiska sotadigan rastalar bor
  • SOSISKA — Finlandiyaning sevimli taomi
  • pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi, a'lo pivo tayyorlaydi
  • ISH KUNLARI oilalar odatda birga kechki ovqat qilmaydi
  • DAM OLISH KUNLARI ba'zan do'stlari bilan ovqatlanadi
  • birga ovqat pishiradi yoki har kim bir qism taom olib keladi

tasks.en: There are a lot of different Finnish dishes, such as smoked fish and hot soups, but fast food such as pizza and sausages are also very popular.
tasks.uz: Turli fin taomlari bor — masalan, dudlangan baliq va issiq sho'rvalar, lekin pitsa va sosiska kabi tez ovqatlar ham juda mashhur.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  such as = masalan, ...kabi
  smoked fish = dudlangan baliq
  popular = mashhur, ommabop
'Finnish' = fin (sifat); 'a Finn' = fin (odam).

tasks.en: In the streets there are stalls which sell sausages, Finland's favourite food.
tasks.uz: Ko'chalarda sosiska sotadigan rastalar bor — bu Finlandiyaning sevimli taomi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  a stall = rasta, kichik do'kon (ko'chada)
  to sell = sotmoq
'which' = ...ki, ...digan (rastalarni tavsiflaydi).
'Finland's favourite food' — egalik apostrofi.

tasks.en: Finns like drinking beer. They make excellent beer.
tasks.uz: Finlar pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ular a'lo pivo tayyorlaydi.
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 16a-mashqdagi 3-gap uchun muhim —
PIVO, vino emas!
'excellent' = a'lo (55-betda ham bor edi).

tasks.en: During the week, most families don't usually have dinner together.
tasks.uz: Hafta davomida ko'pchilik oilalar odatda birga kechki ovqat qilmaydi.
tasks.note:
'during the week' = ish kunlari (dushanbadan jumagacha).
'most families' = ko'pchilik oilalar (artiklsiz).

tasks.en: Sometimes at the weekends they eat with their friends.
tasks.uz: Ba'zan dam olish kunlari ular do'stlari bilan ovqatlanadi.
tasks.note:
'AT the weekends' — britancha (amerikacha 'on the weekends').
Grammar Book 29-betda bu qoida bor edi.

tasks.en: They cook meals together, or each person makes and brings a part of the meal.
tasks.uz: Ular birga ovqat pishiradi yoki har bir odam taomning bir qismini tayyorlab olib keladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  each person = har bir odam
  to bring = olib kelmoq
'each person' — BIRLIK → fe'llar -S bilan: makeS, bringS.

'Whether at home or in a restaurant' = uydami yoki restorandami.
DIQQAT: 'weather' (ob-havo) bilan bir xil o'qiladi: /ˈweðə/.

'strong' = kuchli, quyuq. Aksi: 'weak coffee' (suyuq qahva).

'As well as fruit drinks, they also make beer.'
'and' dan kuchliroq — qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shadi.

'two snacks in between' = orasida ikki marta gazak.
Masalan: pechene, meva, buterbrod.

'invite people to eat with them' = odamlarni birga ovqatlanishga chaqirmoq.
Ot shakli: an invitation (taklifnoma).

'It's polite to leave a little food' = bir oz taom qoldirish odobli.
Aksi: rude (qo'pol).

'leave a little food on the plate' = tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirmoq.
DIQQAT: 'to leave' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'jo'namoq, tark etmoq'.

'Finnish dishes, such as smoked fish' = fin taomlari, masalan dudlangan baliq.
55-betda ham bor edi.

'to smoke' = dudlamoq (tutunda pishirmoq).
'smoked' — sifatdosh.
DIQQAT: 'to smoke' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'chekmoq'.

'very popular' = juda mashhur.
Ot shakli: popularity (mashhurlik).

'stalls which sell sausages' = sosiska sotadigan rastalar.
Bozorda va ko'chada bo'ladi.

Aksi: 'to buy' (sotib olmoq).
DIQQAT: sell — sotmoq; buy — sotib olmoq. Chalkashtirmang.

'each person makes and brings' — 'each' dan keyin BIRLIK ot va fe'l -S bilan.
'each' = har bir (alohida-alohida).

'brings a part of the meal' = taomning bir qismini olib keladi.
Aksi: 'to take' (olib ketmoq).

MATNLARDAGI MAVZULAR BO'YICHA GAPIRING:

tasks.answer: In Uzbekistan, most people have three meals a day: breakfast, lunch and dinner.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then complete the spelling rules.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng imlo qoidalarini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:
  SINGULAR   PLURAL
  loaf     - loaVES
  cherry   - cherrIES
  boy      - boyS
  tomato   - tomatoES

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:

  1) Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f and take
     ............ to form their plural.
     = -f yoki -fe bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -f ni tashlab,
       ko'plik yasash uchun ...... oladi.

  2) Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take
     ...... .
     = UNDOSH + y bilan tugagan otlar -y ni tashlab ...... oladi.

  3) Nouns ending in a vowel + y take -s.  (BERILGAN)
     = UNLI + y bilan tugagan otlar -s oladi.

  4) Some nouns ending in -o take ............ .
     = -o bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar ...... oladi.

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI SOLISHTIRING:
  cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH + y → cherrIES
  boY     — 'o' UNLI + y  → boyS

tasks.prompt: Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f and take ............ to form their plural.
tasks.whyUz:
loaf → loaVES.
Boshqa misollar: knife → knives, leaf → leaves,
wife → wives, life → lives, shelf → shelves.
ISTISNO: roof → roofs, chief → chiefs.

tasks.whyUz:
cherry → cherrIES ('r' — undosh).
Boshqa misollar: strawberry → strawberries,
baby → babies, city → cities, story → stories.

tasks.whyUz:
tomato → tomatoES.
Boshqa misollar: potato → potatoes, hero → heroes.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the plural forms of the words below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlarning ko'plik shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir so'z uchun 6-mashqdagi QAYSI qoida ishlashini aniqlang:
  -f / -fe → -VES
  undosh + y → -IES
  unli + y → -S
  -o → -ES

tasks.whyUz:
4-qoida: -o → -ES = potatoES.
'potatos' XATO.

1-qoida: -fe → -VES = kniVES.
Talaffuz: knife /naɪf/ → knives /naɪvz/ ('k' o'qilmaydi).
2-qoida: undosh ('r') + y → -IES = strawberrIES.

1-qoida: -f → -VES = leaVES.
'a leaf' = barg (42-betdagi koala matnida bor edi).

3-qoida: unli ('e') + y → -S = keyS.
DIQQAT: 'keies' XATO — 'e' unli, shuning uchun y o'zgarmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Countable - Uncountable Nouns
exercises.instructionUz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TURDAGI OT:

  COUNTABLE (sanaladigan)
     Sanash mumkin: 1/2/3/4 apples
     BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor: an apple / apples
     'a/an' bilan keladi

  UNCOUNTABLE (sanalmaydigan)
     Sanab bo'lmaydi: some meat, some sugar
     Faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
     'a/an' bilan KELMAYDI

QOIDALAR:
  • A/AN faqat SANALADIGAN otning BIRLIGI bilan:
       a tomato, an egg
       'A SUGAR' XATO!
  • SOME ikkalasi bilan ham:
       sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
       sanalmaydigan:       some bread

QANDAY ANIQLASH:
  Otning oldiga son qo'yib ko'ring:
     'two apples' — mumkin → SANALADIGAN
     'two sugars' — mumkin emas → SANALMAYDIGAN

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR ODATDA:
  suyuqlik (water, milk, juice, coffee, tea)
  kukun/donador (sugar, salt, flour, rice)
  massa (bread, cheese, meat, butter, jam, honey, ham)

tasks.en: Countable - Uncountable Nouns
Countable nouns are those which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — 1/2/3/4 apples
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otlar — sanash mumkin bo'lganlari. Ularning birlik va ko'plik shakli bor. — 1/2/3/4 olma

tasks.en: Uncountable nouns are those which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — some meat/sugar
tasks.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar — sanab bo'lmaydiganlari. Ularning faqat birlik shakli bor. — bir oz go'sht/shakar

tasks.en: A/An is only used with countable nouns in the singular. — a tomato / an egg (NOT: a sugar)
tasks.uz: A/An faqat sanaladigan otning birligi bilan ishlatiladi. — bitta pomidor / bitta tuxum ('a sugar' EMAS)
tasks.note: 'an' — UNLI TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so'z oldida: an egg, an apple, an onion.

tasks.en: Some is used with either countable nouns in the plural or uncountable nouns. — some bread / some biscuits
tasks.uz: Some sanaladigan otning ko'pligi yoki sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlatiladi. — bir oz non / bir nechta pechene
tasks.note:
'either ... or ...' = yo ... yo ...
DIQQAT: 'some' SANALADIGAN BIRLIK bilan ISHLATILMAYDI:
'some apple' — noto'g'ri (agar bitta olma bo'lsa 'an apple').

exercises.instructionEn: First, say which nouns are countable and which are uncountable, then fill in a/an or some.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval qaysi otlar sanaladigan va qaysilari sanalmaydigan ekanini ayting, so'ng a/an yoki some qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
15 TA SO'Z RASMLAR BILAN BERILGAN:
  honey, tomatoes, jam, rice, coffee, cherries,
  egg, ham, sugar, flour, sandwich, butter,
  water, salt, pepper

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK  → a / an
     an egg, a sandwich
  SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → some
     some tomatoes, some cherries
  SANALMAYDIGAN       → some
     some honey, some rice, some water

DIQQAT — 'an' QACHON:
  Unli TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: an egg, an apple, an onion.

DIQQAT — 'pepper' IKKI MA'NODA:
  a pepper (sanaladi) = bulg'or qalampiri (sabzavot)
  pepper (sanalmaydi) = qora qalampir (ziravor)
  Rasmda ZIRAVOR idishi bor → SANALMAYDIGAN → some pepper.

tasks.whyUz:
SANALMAYDIGAN (suyuq massa) → SOME honey.
'a honey' XATO. 'two honeys' ham noto'g'ri.

SANALADIGAN, lekin KO'PLIKDA → SOME tomatoes.
Bittasi bo'lsa: 'a tomato'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME jam.
'jam' = murabbo, jem.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME rice.
Donalarini sanab bo'lmaydi.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME coffee.
DIQQAT: restoranda 'two coffees' deyish mumkin —
bu 'ikki piyola qahva' degani (qisqartma shakl).

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → SOME cherries.
Bittasi: 'a cherry'.

tasks.promptUz: Bitta tuxum, unli tovush bilan boshlanadi
tasks.whyUz:
SANALADIGAN, BIRLIKDA → 'an' (unli tovush → AN).
'a egg' XATO.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME ham.
'ham' = dudlangan cho'chqa go'shti.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME sugar.
Nazariya qutisida ham misol sifatida berilgan: 'NOT: a sugar'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME flour.
'flour' /ˈflaʊə/ = un.
DIQQAT: 'a flower' /ˈflaʊə/ = gul — bir xil o'qiladi!

SANALADIGAN, BIRLIKDA → 'a sandwich'.
Ko'pligi: sandwiches (-ch → -ES).

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME butter.
'butter' = sariyog'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME water.
Sanash uchun: 'a glass of water'.
SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME salt.

Rasmda ZIRAVOR (qora qalampir) → SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME pepper.
DIQQAT: 'a pepper' = bulg'or qalampiri (sabzavot, sanaladi).

exercises.explanationUz:
XARID RO'YXATI (Shopping List):
  2 kilos of meat  ✓ (kerak — kitobda belgilangan)

  S2: She needs two kilos of meat. How MANY eggs does she need?

  SANALMAYDIGAN → How MUCH ... does she need?

  SANALADIGAN → How MANY ... does she need?
     tomatoes, bananas, eggs

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  KERAK bo'lsa:     She needs + miqdor + of + ot.
  KERAK EMAS bo'lsa: She doesn't need ANY + ot.

  She doesn't need ANY eggs.
  ('She doesn't need some eggs' XATO)

DIQQAT — 'tomatoes' BILAN 'How MANY':
  Ro'yxatda '1 kilo of tomatoes' deyilgan bo'lsa ham,
  'tomatoes' o'zi SANALADIGAN ot → How MANY tomatoes?

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG:

  SA: Is there ANY milk in the fridge?
  SB: No, I'm afraid there isn't ANY milk.
      Would you like SOME Coke instead?
  SA: Yes, please. I'd love SOME.
      Can I have SOME ice too?
  SB: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Muzlatgichda sut bormi?
  SB: Yo'q, afsuski sut yo'q. Uning o'rniga kola xohlaysizmi?
  SA: Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim. Muz ham olsam bo'ladimi?
  SB: Ha, albatta.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use SOME in the affirmative. We also use ......
  in the interrogative form for OFFERS or REQUESTS.
  We use ...... in the negative and interrogative form.

ASOSIY QOIDA:

  SOME →  TASDIQ gapda
            There is some milk.
          + SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF yoki ILTIMOS bo'lsa
            Would you like SOME Coke?   (taklif)
            Can I have SOME ice?        (iltimos)

  ANY  →  INKOR gapda
            There isn't ANY milk.
          + oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'raganda)
            Is there ANY milk in the fridge?

DIQQAT — 'I'm afraid' = afsuski (yomon xabarni yumshatadi).
DIQQAT — 'instead' = o'rniga (gap oxirida turadi).

  'Would YOU like ...?'  → sizga TAKLIF qilinyapti

  1) -F yoki -FE bilan tugasa → -VES
       loaf - loaVES,  knife - kniVES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: cliff - cliffS,  roof - roofS

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa → -IES
       cherry - cherrIES,  lady - ladIES

  3) UNLI + Y bilan tugasa → -S
       boy - boyS,  toy - toyS

  4) -O bilan tugasa → -ES
       tomato - tomatoES,  potato - potatoES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: radio - radioS,  photo - photoS

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI FARQLASH:
  'y' dan OLDINGI harfga qarang:
     cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH → cherrIES
     boY     — 'o' UNLI   → boyS

ISTISNOLARNI YOD OLING:
  -f/-fe lekin -S: cliff, roof, chief, belief
  -o lekin -S:     radio, photo, piano, video

tasks.en: Plurals — spelling rules.
Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f or -fe and take -ves to form their plural. — loaf - loaves, knife - knives
tasks.uz: -f yoki -fe bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -f/-fe ni tashlab, ko'plik yasash uchun -ves oladi. — non - nonlar, pichoq - pichoqlar
tasks.note: Boshqa misollar: leaf - leaves, wife - wives, life - lives, shelf - shelves.

tasks.en: BUT: cliff - cliffs, roof - roofs
tasks.note:
ISTISNOLAR — bu otlar oddiy -S oladi.
Yana: chief - chiefs, belief - beliefs.

tasks.en: Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take -ies. — cherry - cherries, lady - ladies
tasks.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan otlar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi. — gilos - giloslar, xonim - xonimlar
tasks.note:
'y' dan OLDINGI harf UNDOSH bo'lishi kerak.
Yana: baby - babies, city - cities, story - stories.

tasks.en: Nouns ending in a vowel + y, take -s. — boy - boys, toy - toys
tasks.uz: Unli + y bilan tugagan otlar -s oladi. — bola - bolalar, o'yinchoq - o'yinchoqlar
tasks.note:
'y' dan oldin UNLI (a, e, i, o, u) bo'lsa, y O'ZGARMAYDI.
Yana: day - days, key - keys, monkey - monkeys.

tasks.en: Some nouns ending in -o take -es. — tomato - tomatoes, potato - potatoes
tasks.uz: -o bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -es oladi. — pomidor - pomidorlar, kartoshka - kartoshkalar

tasks.en: BUT: radio - radios, photo - photos
tasks.note:
ISTISNOLAR — bu otlar oddiy -S oladi.
Yana: piano - pianos, video - videos, kilo - kilos.

exercises.instructionEn: Countable / Uncountable Nouns and phrases of quantity.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar hamda miqdor iboralari.
exercises.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN OTLAR (Countable):
  • sanash mumkin: one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
  • BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor
  • BIRLIKDA: a/an bilan → a cherry, an orange
  • KO'PLIKDA: some bilan → some cherries, some oranges

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR (Uncountable):
  • sanab bo'lmaydi
  • faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
  • 'breads', 'butters' — XATO
  • some bilan → some bread, some butter
  • a/an bilan ISHLATILMAYDI

MIQDOR IBORALARI (phrases of quantity):
  slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet
  + OF + ot
     a bottle OF water
     a kilo OF apples

Bu iboralar SANALADIGAN otlar bilan ham,
SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Countable / Uncountable Nouns and phrases of quantity.
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar hamda miqdor iboralari.

tasks.en: Countable nouns are those nouns which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otlar — sanash mumkin bo'lganlari. Ularning birlik va ko'plik shakli bor. — bitta limon, ikkita limon, uchta limon

tasks.en: We use a/an with countable nouns in the singular. — a cherry, an orange
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otning birligi bilan a/an ishlatamiz. — bitta gilos, bitta apelsin
tasks.note: 'an' — UNLI TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so'z oldida: an orange, an apple, an egg.

tasks.en: We use some with countable nouns in the plural. — some cherries, some oranges
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan some ishlatamiz. — bir nechta gilos, bir nechta apelsin

tasks.en: Uncountable nouns are those nouns which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — bread, butter (NOT: breads, butters)
tasks.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar — sanab bo'lmaydiganlari. Ularning faqat birlik shakli bor. — non, sariyog' ('breads', 'butters' EMAS)

tasks.en: We can use some with uncountable nouns. — some bread, some butter
tasks.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan some ishlatishimiz mumkin. — bir oz non, bir oz sariyog'

tasks.en: We can use countable and uncountable nouns in phrases of quantity such as: slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet + of. — a bottle of water, a kilo of apples
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni miqdor iboralaridan keyin ishlatishimiz mumkin: slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet + of. — bir shisha suv, bir kilo olma
tasks.note:
'OF' HECH QACHON TUSHIB QOLMAYDI.
'a bottle water' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.
exercises.instructionUz: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOW MUCH / HOW MANY:
  how MUCH → SANALMAYDIGAN
     How much bread do you want?
  how MANY → SANALADIGAN
     How many potatoes do you want?

A FEW / A LITTLE:
  a FEW (= not many; some) → SANALADIGAN
     I want a few biscuits.
  a LITTLE (= not much; some) → SANALMAYDIGAN
     I want a little milk.

SOME / ANY:
  SOME → TASDIQ gapda
           sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
           sanalmaydigan:       some milk
       → SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF (offer) yoki ILTIMOS (request):
           Would you like some biscuits?   (offer)
           Can I have some water, please?  (request)

  ANY  → INKOR gapda
           I haven't got any strawberries.
       → oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'rash)
           Have you got any milk?

ESLAB QOLISH USULI:
  MANY va FEW — SANALADIGAN
  MUCH va LITTLE — SANALMAYDIGAN
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 34-bet, nazariya (How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any)

tasks.en: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.
tasks.uz: How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any.

tasks.en: We use how much with uncountable nouns. — How much bread do you want?
tasks.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan how much ishlatamiz. — Sizga qancha non kerak?
tasks.note: 'how much' narx so'rash uchun ham: 'How much is it?'

tasks.en: We use how many with countable nouns. — How many potatoes do you want?
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan how many ishlatamiz. — Sizga nechta kartoshka kerak?
tasks.note: 'how many' dan keyin ot DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

tasks.en: We use a few (= not many; some) with countable nouns. — I want a few biscuits.
tasks.uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan a few (= ko'p emas; bir nechta) ishlatamiz. — Menga bir nechta pechene kerak.
tasks.note:
'a few' = bir nechta (ijobiy ma'no).
DIQQAT: 'few' (a-siz) = juda kam (salbiy ma'no).

tasks.en: We use a little (= not much; some) with uncountable nouns. — I want a little milk.
tasks.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a little (= ko'p emas; bir oz) ishlatamiz. — Menga bir oz sut kerak.
tasks.note:
'a little' = bir oz (ijobiy ma'no).
DIQQAT: 'little' (a-siz) = juda oz (salbiy ma'no).

tasks.en: We use some in the affirmative with countable nouns in the plural and uncountable nouns. — I want some biscuits and some milk.
tasks.uz: Tasdiq gapda sanaladigan otning ko'pligi va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan some ishlatamiz. — Menga bir nechta pechene va bir oz sut kerak.

tasks.en: We use some in the interrogative form for offers or requests. — Would you like some biscuits? (offer) Can I have some water, please? (request)
tasks.uz: So'roq shaklda taklif yoki iltimos uchun some ishlatamiz. — Pechene xohlaysizmi? (taklif) Suv olsam bo'ladimi? (iltimos)
tasks.note:
an offer = taklif (siz beryapsiz)
a request = iltimos (siz so'rayapsiz)

tasks.en: We use any in the negative and interrogative form. — I haven't got any strawberries. Have you got any milk?
tasks.uz: Inkor va so'roq shaklda any ishlatamiz. — Menda qulupnay yo'q. Sizda sut bormi?
tasks.note:
INKOR: haven't got ANY
MA'LUMOT SO'RASH: Have you got ANY ...?

exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'PLIK -S QO'ShIMCHASI UCH XIL O'QILADI.
QAYSI TOVUSH — SO'ZNING OXIRGI TOVUSHIGA BOG'LIQ:

  /ɪz/ — SIZILDOQ tovushdan keyin
         /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/
         glassES, sandwichES, boxES, watchES, bridgES
         (qo'shimcha BO'G'IN qo'shiladi!)

  /s/  — JARANGSIZ undoshdan keyin
         /p/, /t/, /k/, /f/, /θ/
         cakeS, carrotS, bookS, cupS, cats

  /z/  — JARANGLI undosh va UNLIdan keyin
         /b/, /d/, /g/, /v/, /m/, /n/, /l/, /r/ va unlilar
         loaveS, cherrieS, dogS, penS, boyS

QANDAY TEKSHIRISH:
  Bo'g'in qo'shildimi? → /ɪz/
  Qo'shilmagan bo'lsa, oxirgi tovush jarangsizmi? → /s/
  Jaranglimi yoki unlimi? → /z/

BU QOIDA fe'lning 3-shaxs -S qo'shimchasiga ham tegishli:
  works /s/, plays /z/, watches /ɪz/

tasks.whyUz:
cake /keɪk/ — oxirgi tovush /k/ JARANGSIZ → /s/.
O'qilishi: /keɪks/.

loaf → loaves. Oxirgi tovush /v/ JARANGLI → /z/.
O'qilishi: /ləʊvz/.
DIQQAT: 'f' → 'v' ga aylandi (56-betdagi qoida).

glass /ɡlɑːs/ — oxirgi tovush /s/ SIZILDOQ → /ɪz/.
O'qilishi: /ˈɡlɑːsɪz/ — QO'ShIMCHA BO'G'IN qo'shildi.

sandwich — oxirgi tovush /tʃ/ SIZILDOQ → /ɪz/.
O'qilishi: /ˈsænwɪdʒɪz/ — qo'shimcha bo'g'in.
DIQQAT: 'sandwich' da 'd' ko'pincha O'QILMAYDI.

cherry → cherries. Oxiri UNLI tovush → /z/.
O'qilishi: /ˈtʃeriz/.
DIQQAT: yozilishida 'ies' bo'lsa ham, qo'shimcha bo'g'in QO'ShILMAYDI.

carrot /ˈkærət/ — oxirgi tovush /t/ JARANGSIZ → /s/.
O'qilishi: /ˈkærəts/.

exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang va takrorlang. So'ng quyidagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1) ICHIMLIK haqida (I'm thirsty)
  2) OVQAT haqida (I'm hungry)

ASOSIY IBORALAR:
  I'm thirsty. = Chanqadim.
  I'm hungry.  = Qornim ochdi.
  Is there anything to drink/eat? = Ichgani/yegani bir narsa bormi?
  Would you like ...? = ... xohlaysizmi? (MULOYIM taklif)
  No, thanks. = Yo'q, rahmat. (muloyim rad etish)
  How about ...? = ...-chi? (boshqa taklif)
  Oh, yes, please! = Ha, iltimos!
  I'd love ... = Men ... juda xohlardim. (= I would love)

DIQQAT — 'SOME' yoki 'A':
  SANALMAYDIGAN → some orange juice, some Coke, some tea
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → a ham sandwich, a cheese sandwich

tasks.en: A (1-dialog): I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink?
B: Would you like some orange juice?
A: No, thanks. I don't like orange juice.
tasks.uz: Yo'q, rahmat. Men apelsin sharbatini yoqtirmayman.

tasks.en: B: How about some Coke?
A: Oh, yes, please! I'd love some Coke!
tasks.uz: Ha, iltimos! Men kolani juda xohlardim!

tasks.en: A (2-dialog): I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
tasks.uz: Qornim ochdi. Yegani bir narsa bormi?

tasks.en: B: Would you like a ham sandwich?
A: No, thanks. I don't like ham.
B: How about a cheese sandwich?
A: Oh, yes, please! I'd love a cheese sandwich!
tasks.uz: Ha, iltimos! Men pishloqli buterbrodni juda xohlardim!

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ — BUTUN BETNING TAKRORI.

XATO TURLARI:

  1) SOME / A / AN noto'g'ri ishlatilgan
       some banana → A banana (sanaladigan birlik)
       a water → SOME water (sanalmaydigan)

  2) SOME / ANY noto'g'ri
       Can I have ANY bread? → SOME (iltimos savoli)

  3) 'I like' o'rniga 'I'd like' kerak
       'I like' = yoqtiraman (umuman)
       'I'd like' = xohlayman (hozir)

  4) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many honey? → How MUCH (sanalmaydigan)
       How much oranges? → How MANY (sanaladigan)

  5) A FEW / A LITTLE noto'g'ri
       milk uchun 'a few' → A LITTLE

  6) Sanalmaydigan otga -s qo'shilgan
       some sugars → some SUGAR

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1-band ('some' chizib tashlangan, 'a' yozilgan).

tasks.prompt: 2  I'm thirsty. I'd like a water. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME water.
(Yoki: 'a glass of water'.)
tasks.speak: 2  I'm thirsty. I'd like a water. → ............

tasks.prompt: 3  Can I have any bread, please? → ............
tasks.whyUz:
ILTIMOS (request) savolida SOME ishlatiladi.
To'g'ri gap: Can I have SOME bread, please?
13-mashqdagi qoida.
tasks.speak: 3  Can I have any bread, please? → ............

tasks.prompt: 4  I'm hungry. I like a hamburger. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'I like' = umuman yoqtiraman.
'I'd like' (= I WOULD like) = hozir xohlayman.
Qorni ochgan odam 'I'D LIKE a hamburger' deydi.
tasks.speak: 4  I'm hungry. I like a hamburger. → ............

tasks.prompt: 5  Would you like some tea? Yes, I love some. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'I love some' — noto'g'ri.
To'g'ri: 'Yes, I'D LOVE some.' (= I WOULD love)
Taklifga javobda DOIM 'I'd love' ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: 5  Would you like some tea? Yes, I love some. → ............

tasks.prompt: 6  Do you like a cup of tea? Yes, please. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'Yes, please' — TAKLIFGA javob, shuning uchun savol ham
taklif bo'lishi kerak: 'WOULD YOU LIKE a cup of tea?'
'Do you like tea?' savoliga javob 'Yes, I do' bo'lardi.
tasks.speak: 6  Do you like a cup of tea? Yes, please. → ............

tasks.speak: 7  I'd like some sugars in my tea. → ............

tasks.speak: 8  How many honey do you need? → ............

'butter' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.

tasks.speak: 9  Could I have a butter please? → ............

'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE ('a few' XATO).
To'g'ri javob: 'Just A LITTLE, please.'

tasks.speak: 10  "Would you like some milk in your tea?" "Just a few, please." → ............

DIQQAT: inkorda ('I don't like bacon') 'some' KERAK EMAS.
tasks.speak: 11  I'd like eggs but I don't like bacon. → ............

tasks.speak: 12  How many wine is there in the fridge? → ............

exercises.instructionEn: Write the plural forms of the words below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlarning ko'plik shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR SO'Z UCHUN AVVAL OXIRGI HARFLARGA QARANG:
  -f / -fe  → -VES  (istisnolar bor!)
  undosh + y → -IES
  unli + y   → -S
  -o         → -ES  (istisnolar bor!)
  qolganlari → -S

tasks.whyUz: 2-qoida: undosh ('r') + y → -IES = cherrIES.

ISTISNO! -f bilan tugasa ham -VES OLMAYDI → cliffS.
Nazariya qutisida ham aynan shu misol berilgan.
'a cliff' = qoya, jarlik.

2-qoida: undosh ('l') + y → -IES = butterflIES.
'a butterfly' = kapalak (6-unitda ham bor edi).
4-qoida: -o → -ES = tomatoES.

ISTISNO! -o bilan tugasa ham -ES OLMAYDI → radioS.
Nazariya qutisida ham aynan shu misol berilgan.
Unli bilan tugaydi (lekin -o emas) → oddiy -S = bananaS.

3-qoida: UNLI ('o') + y → -S = toyS.
'toies' XATO.

1-qoida: -f → -VES = loaVES.
2-band bilan solishtiring: 'cliff' istisno, 'loaf' esa qoidaga bo'ysunadi.

ISTISNO! → photoS.
4-band bilan solishtiring: 'tomato' → tomatoES, 'photo' → photoS.

2-qoida: undosh ('t') + y → -IES = citIES.
'a city' = shahar.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  I'd like A water, please.  →  SOME
     ('a' chizib tashlangan, 'some' yozilgan)

XATO TURLARI:

  1) SANALMAYDIGAN otga 'a/an' qo'yilgan
       a water → SOME water
       a soup → SOME soup
       a salt → ANY salt

  2) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many butter → How MUCH
       How much eggs → How MANY

  3) SANALMAYDIGAN otga -S qo'shilgan
       some hams → some HAM
       some cheeses → some CHEESE

  4) SOME / ANY noto'g'ri
       Would you like ANY coffee? → SOME (taklif)
       Can I have ANY milk? → SOME (iltimos)
       I haven't got SOME biscuits. → ANY (inkor)

  5) A FEW / A LITTLE noto'g'ri
       a little carrots → A FEW (sanaladigan)

  6) Ko'plik imlosi noto'g'ri
       cherrys → CHERRIES

sentencePatterns.formula: I like / I don't like + ovqat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like pizza and ice-cream. I don't like coconut or garlic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga pitsa va muzqaymoq yoqadi. Kokos va sarimsoq yoqmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ gapda sanashda 'and', INKOR gapda 'OR' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X, Y and Z are + guruh nomi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Carrots, potatoes and onions are vegetables.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sabzi, kartoshka va piyoz — sabzavotlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Turkumlashda ega ham, guruh nomi ham KO'PLIKDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: When do you eat/have + ovqat? — At + soat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When do you eat breakfast? — At seven o'clock in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nonushtani qachon qilasiz? — Ertalab soat yettida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner' oldida ARTIKL KERAK EMAS.
Aniq soat oldida AT.

sentencePatterns.formula: How often do you eat + ovqat? — every day / twice a week.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you eat fruit? — I eat fruit every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mevani qanchalik tez-tez yeysiz? — Har kuni yeyman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How often' — chastota savoli.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can have + ovqat + FOR + breakfast/dessert.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can have ice-cream for dessert.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shirinlikka muzqaymoq olsangiz bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have ... FOR + ovqat vaqti' — 'for' predlogi shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is open FROM ... TILL ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Laura's is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Laura's' ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from ... till/until ...' = ...dan ...gacha.

sentencePatterns.formula: A meal for two COSTS about £25.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A meal for two costs about £25.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'A meal' — birlik ega → COSTS.
'£25' = 'twenty-five pounds'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are a lot of + ot + TO CHOOSE FROM, SUCH AS + misollar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak and roast chicken.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tanlash uchun ko'p mazali taomlar bor: masalan, qalampirli bifshteks va qovurilgan tovuq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = masalan (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: DON'T MISS the chance TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyda pishirilgan nonni tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyruq gapning inkori. 'chance TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: For dessert, have + a slice of / a bowl of + shirinlik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: For dessert, have a slice of apple pie or a bowl of ice-cream.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shirinlikka bir bo'lak olmali pirog yoki bir kosa muzqaymoq oling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'FOR dessert' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Miqdor iborasi: a slice OF, a bowl OF.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is open FROM ... TILL ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from ... till ...' — ish vaqtini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ..., SO don't forget TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' = shuning uchun (natija).
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: We eat/cut/pick up food WITH a + asbob.  /  We fry eggs IN a frying-pan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We eat soup with a spoon. We fry eggs in a frying-pan.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz sho'rvani qoshiq bilan yeymiz. Tuxumni tovada qovuramiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ASBOB uchun WITH.
IDISH ICHIDA bo'lsa IN.
Idish YUZASIDA bo'lsa ON (on a plate).

sentencePatterns.formula: A/AN + sanaladigan BIRLIK  /  SOME + sanaladigan KO'PLIK yoki sanalmaydigan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: an egg, a sandwich / some tomatoes, some bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: bitta tuxum, bitta buterbrod / pomidorlar, bir oz non
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'a sugar' XATO — 'sugar' sanalmaydi.
'some apple' ham noto'g'ri, agar bitta olma bo'lsa → 'an apple'.

sentencePatterns.formula: a/two/three + miqdor so'zi + OF + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a glass of water, two cups of tea, a loaf of bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: bir stakan suv, ikki piyola choy, bir non
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'OF' hech qachon tushib qolmaydi.
Ko'plikda MIQDOR so'zi o'zgaradi: two glassES of water.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm thirsty/hungry. Is there anything to drink/eat?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chanqadim. Ichgani bir narsa bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'anything' — savolda 'biror narsa'.
'to drink/eat' — 'anything' dan keyin 'to + fe'l'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like + some/a + ovqat? — No, thanks. / Yes, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like some orange juice? — No, thanks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Apelsin sharbati xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Would you like ...?' — eng muloyim taklif shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: How about + some/a + ovqat? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How about some Coke? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love some Coke!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kola-chi? — Ha, iltimos! Men kolani juda xohlardim!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How about ...?' — birinchi taklif rad etilgach, ikkinchisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ko'plik yasash: -f/-fe → -ves;  undosh+y → -ies;  unli+y → -s;  -o → -es.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: loaf → loaves, cherry → cherries, boy → boys, tomato → tomatoes
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: non → nonlar, gilos → giloslar, bola → bolalar, pomidor → pomidorlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Avval OXIRGI HARFLARGA qarang, so'ng qoidani tanlang.

sentencePatterns.formula: How MUCH + sanalmaydigan + do you need? — Just a LITTLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much milk do you need? — Just a little.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizga qancha sut kerak? — Bir oz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUCH va LITTLE — ikkalasi ham SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: How MANY + sanaladigan (ko'plik) + do you need? — Just a FEW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many carrots do you need? — Just a few.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizga nechta sabzi kerak? — Bir nechta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MANY va FEW — ikkalasi ham SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: She needs + miqdor + OF + ot.  /  She doesn't need ANY + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She needs two kilos of meat. She doesn't need any eggs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unga ikki kilo go'sht kerak. Unga tuxum kerak emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: INKORDA doim ANY: 'doesn't need ANY eggs'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is/Are there ANY ...? — No, there isn't/aren't ANY ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there any milk in the fridge? — No, I'm afraid there isn't any milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muzlatgichda sut bormi? — Yo'q, afsuski sut yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ma'lumot so'rash savolida va inkorda ANY.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like SOME ...? (taklif)  /  Can I have SOME ...? (iltimos)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like some Coke? Can I have some ice too?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kola xohlaysizmi? Muz ham olsam bo'ladimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TAKLIF va ILTIMOS savollarida SOME (any EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes, PLEASE. I'd love some.  /  No, THANKS. I don't like ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like cakes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim. — Yo'q, rahmat. Men tortni yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QABUL → PLEASE.  RAD → THANKS.
Rad etganda SABAB aytish — muloyimlik belgisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'd like + some/a + ovqat, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like a banana, please. I'd like some water, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga banan bering, iltimos. Menga suv bering, iltimos.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → A.  SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME.
'I like' EMAS, 'I'D like' (= I would like).

sentencePatterns.formula: X like + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Brazilians like eating with their friends. Finns like drinking beer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Braziliyaliklar do'stlari bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi. Finlar pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'like' dan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING bilan.
'like TO + fe'l' ham mumkin: 'like to invite'.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's polite / It isn't polite TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's polite to leave a little food on the plate.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish odobli hisoblanadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'It's + sifat + TO + fe'l' — umumiy fikr bildirish qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are stalls WHICH sell ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In the streets there are stalls which sell sausages.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'chalarda sosiska sotadigan rastalar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'which' — narsani tavsiflaydi ('...digan', '...ki').
Odam uchun 'who' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Each person + fe'l-S (BIRLIK).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Each person makes and brings a part of the meal.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har bir odam taomning bir qismini tayyorlab olib keladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'each' — BIRLIK: 'each person MAKES' ('make' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I have + a/some + ovqat, please? — Yes, here you are.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I have a hamburger, please? — Yes, here you are.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gamburger olsam bo'ladimi? — Ha, mana, oling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyurtma berish qolipi. 'please' — muloyimlik uchun shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: How much is it? — It's + narx. Anything else? — No, thanks.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much is it? — It's one pound sixty. Anything else? — No, thanks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qancha turadi? — Bir funt oltmish. Yana biror narsa kerakmi? — Yo'q, rahmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Anything else?' = yana biror narsa kerakmi?
Javob: 'No, thanks' yoki 'Yes, can I have ...?'

sentencePatterns.formula: Whether ... or ..., + asosiy gap.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whether at home or in a restaurant, Brazilians like eating with their family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uydami yoki restorandami, braziliyaliklar oilasi bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'whether ... or ...' = farqi yo'q, ikkalasida ham.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like TO + fe'l? (muloyim taklif)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like to look at the menu? Would you like to order your dessert now?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menyuga qaramoqchimisiz? Shirinlikni hozir buyurtma qilmoqchimisiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Would you like TO + fe'l' — ish taklif qilish.
'Would you like + ot' — narsa taklif qilish.

sentencePatterns.formula: To start with, I'd like + taom.  /  I'd like the + taom.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: To start with I'd like the tomato soup. I'd like the grilled fish.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Birinchi taomga pomidor sho'rvasi olsam. Men panjarada pishirilgan baliq olsam.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'I'd like' = I WOULD like — buyurtma berishning asosiy qolipi.
Menyudagi aniq taom uchun 'THE' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I have + taom, then?  (birinchisi yo'q bo'lsa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's no more roast chicken. — Oh. Can I have a pepper steak, then?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qovurilgan tovuq qolmadi. — Unda qalampirli bifshteks olsam bo'ladimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'then' = unda, u holda (gap OXIRIDA).

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you got ANY + ot?  — I'm sorry, we haven't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you got any strawberries? — I'm sorry, we haven't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizda qulupnay bormi? — Afsuski, yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT so'rash savolida ANY.
Qisqa javob: 'we haven't' (got takrorlanmaydi).

sentencePatterns.formula: Can we have the bill, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can we have the bill, please? — Of course, sir. One moment ...
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hisobni olsak bo'ladimi? — Albatta, janob. Bir daqiqa ...
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Restoranda oxirgi ibora. 'the bill' — britancha.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ko'plik -S: /s/ jarangsizdan, /z/ jaranglidan, /ɪz/ sizildoqdan keyin.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: cakes /s/, loaves /z/, glasses /ɪz/
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: tortlar, nonlar, stakanlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: /ɪz/ da QO'ShIMCHA BO'G'IN qo'shiladi, qolgan ikkisida yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: WITHOUT + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tuxumni sindirmasdan omlet tayyorlab bo'lmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'without' dan keyin fe'l DOIM -ing shaklida.

sentencePatterns.formula: A/AN + sanaladigan BIRLIK  /  SOME + sanaladigan KO'PLIK yoki sanalmaydigan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a cherry, an orange / some cherries, some bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: bitta gilos, bitta apelsin / bir nechta gilos, bir oz non
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sanalmaydigan otga 'a/an' HECH QACHON qo'yilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: How MUCH + sanalmaydigan?  /  How MANY + sanaladigan (ko'plik)?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much bread do you want? How many potatoes do you want?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizga qancha non kerak? Sizga nechta kartoshka kerak?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUCH — sanalmaydigan;  MANY — sanaladigan.

sentencePatterns.formula: a FEW + sanaladigan  /  a LITTLE + sanalmaydigan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I want a few biscuits. I want a little milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga bir nechta pechene kerak. Menga bir oz sut kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
FEW — sanaladigan;  LITTLE — sanalmaydigan.
MANY-FEW va MUCH-LITTLE juftliklarini birga eslang.

sentencePatterns.formula: a/two + miqdor so'zi + OF + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a bottle of water, a kilo of apples
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: bir shisha suv, bir kilo olma
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'OF' shart. Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ham ishlaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: SOME (tasdiq, taklif, iltimos)  /  ANY (inkor, ma'lumot savoli).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I want some milk. Would you like some tea? / I haven't got any milk. Have you got any milk?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga sut kerak. Choy xohlaysizmi? / Menda sut yo'q. Sizda sut bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savol TAKLIF yoki ILTIMOS bo'lsa — SOME.
Oddiy ma'lumot so'rash bo'lsa — ANY.
